visible_ascii_policy.reason: Keep the stock Latin and digit glyphs. All Chinese localization surfaces share the flattened two-byte release mapping and one global Chinese font flavor.

new_character_allocation_policy.applies_to: Every primary assignment appended by update_zh_release_font_snapshot.py, including a character already present in the original text table.
new_character_allocation_policy.historical_exception: Existing primary mappings are immutable and remain protected by the surface-safe alias layer; this exception never authorizes a new assignment in the forbidden range.

scope.selection: Every non-empty translation field under corpus/zh, including menu, database, story and future battle-dialogue corpora.
scope.rerasterize: Every selected visible glyph through the single global HarmonyOS Sans SC flavor, except the explicit stock fullwidth ASCII preservation policy.
scope.preserve: Unselected source glyphs; all runtime placeholders and lossless control notation (%s/%2$s, $c/$f/$l/$n/$F, {XX}, and @?<tag:XX>) through their dedicated encoder paths; archive size; and executable font layout. New character assignments never enter the renderer's 0x8140..0x889E single-character mode range.

manifest_contract.scope: One flattened HarmonyOS Sans SC font/codebook component for every registered Chinese localization corpus. It does not build an ISO or prove runtime rendering.
manifest_contract.runtime_reason: Static component proof only; new-game and load-game runtime entry remain separate release gates.
